column3: In the <p-w s=H7225>beginning</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> the <p-w s=H8064>heaven</p-w> <p-w s=H853>and</p-w> the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let there <p-w s=H1961>be</p-w> <p-w s=H216>light</p-w>: and there was <p-w s=H216>light</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> the <p-w s=H216>light</p-w>, <p-w s=H3588>that</p-w> [it was] <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>: and <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H914>divided</p-w> the <p-w s=H216>light</p-w> <p-w s=H996>from</p-w> the <p-w s=H2822>darkness</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> the <p-w s=H216>light</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>Day</p-w>, and the <p-w s=H2822>darkness</p-w> he <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>Night</p-w>. ¶ And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let there be a <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w> in the <p-w s=H8432>midst</p-w> of the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w>, and let it <p-w s=H914>divide</p-w> the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> from the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> the <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w>, and <p-w s=H914>divided</p-w> the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> <p-w s=H834>which</p-w> [were] <p-w s=H8478>under</p-w> the <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w> from the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> <p-w s=H834>which</p-w> [were] <p-w s=H5921>above</p-w> the <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w>: and it was <p-w s=H3651>so</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> the <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w> <p-w s=H8064>Heaven</p-w>. And the <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w> and the <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w> were the <p-w s=H8145>second</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

¶ And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> under the <p-w s=H8064>heaven</p-w> be gathered <p-w s=H6960>together</p-w> <p-w s=H413>unto</p-w> <p-w s=H259>one</p-w> <p-w s=H4725>place</p-w>, and let the <p-w s=H3004>dry</p-w> [land] <p-w s=H7200>appear</p-w>: and it was so.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> the <p-w s=H3004>dry</p-w> [land] <p-w s=H776>Earth</p-w>; and the gathering <p-w s=H4723>together</p-w> of the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> he <p-w s=H3220>Seas</p-w>: and <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> that [it was] <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>.

And the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> brought <p-w s=H3318>forth</p-w> <p-w s=H1877>grass</p-w>, [and] <p-w s=H6212>herb</p-w> <p-w s=H2232>yielding</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>seed</p-w> after his <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>, and the <p-w s=H6086>tree</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>yielding</p-w> <p-w s=H6529>fruit</p-w>, whose <p-w s=H2233>seed</p-w> [was] in itself, after his <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>: and <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> that [it was] <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>.
And the <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w> and the <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w> were the <p-w s=H7992>third</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

¶ And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let there be <p-w s=H3974>lights</p-w> in the <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w> of the <p-w s=H8064>heaven</p-w> to <p-w s=H914>divide</p-w> the <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> from the <p-w s=H3915>night</p-w>; and let them be for <p-w s=H226>signs</p-w>, and for <p-w s=H4150>seasons</p-w>, and for <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w>, and <p-w s=H8141>years</p-w>:
And let them be for <p-w s=H3974>lights</p-w> in the <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w> of the <p-w s=H8064>heaven</p-w> to give <p-w s=H215>light</p-w> upon the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>: and it was so.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> <p-w s=H8147>two</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>great</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>lights</p-w>; the <p-w s=H1419>greater</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>light</p-w> to <p-w s=H4475>rule</p-w> the <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>, and the <p-w s=H6996>lesser</p-w> <p-w s=H3974>light</p-w> to <p-w s=H4475>rule</p-w> the <p-w s=H3915>night</p-w>: [he made] the <p-w s=H3556>stars</p-w> also.
And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>set</p-w> them in the <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w> of the <p-w s=H8064>heaven</p-w> to give <p-w s=H215>light</p-w> upon the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>,

And to <p-w s=H4910>rule</p-w> over the <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> and over the <p-w s=H3915>night</p-w>, and to <p-w s=H914>divide</p-w> the <p-w s=H216>light</p-w> from the <p-w s=H2822>darkness</p-w>: and <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> that [it was] <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>.
And the <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w> and the <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w> were the <p-w s=H7243>fourth</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> bring forth <p-w s=H8317>abundantly</p-w> the moving <p-w s=H8318>creature</p-w> that <p-w s=H5315>hath</p-w> <p-w s=H2416>life</p-w>, and <p-w s=H5775>fowl</p-w> [that] may <p-w s=H5774>fly</p-w> <p-w s=H5921>above</p-w> the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> in the <p-w s=H6440>open</p-w> <p-w s=H7549>firmament</p-w> of <p-w s=H8064>heaven</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>great</p-w> <p-w s=H8577>whales</p-w>, and every <p-w s=H2416>living</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>creature</p-w> that <p-w s=H7430>moveth</p-w>, which the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> brought forth <p-w s=H8317>abundantly</p-w>, after their <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>, and every <p-w s=H3671>winged</p-w> <p-w s=H5775>fowl</p-w> after his <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>: and <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> that [it was] <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1288>blessed</p-w> them, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>, Be <p-w s=H6509>fruitful</p-w>, and <p-w s=H7235>multiply</p-w>, and <p-w s=H4390>fill</p-w> the <p-w s=H4325>waters</p-w> in the <p-w s=H3220>seas</p-w>, and let <p-w s=H5775>fowl</p-w> <p-w s=H7235>multiply</p-w> in the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>.
And the <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w> and the <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w> were the <p-w s=H2549>fifth</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

¶ And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> bring <p-w s=H3318>forth</p-w> the <p-w s=H2416>living</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>creature</p-w> after his <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>, <p-w s=H929>cattle</p-w>, and creeping <p-w s=H7431>thing</p-w>, and <p-w s=H2416>beast</p-w> of the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> after his <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>: and it was so.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> the <p-w s=H2416>beast</p-w> of the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> after his <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>, and <p-w s=H929>cattle</p-w> after their <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>, and every thing that <p-w s=H7431>creepeth</p-w> upon the <p-w s=H127>earth</p-w> after his <p-w s=H4327>kind</p-w>: and <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> that [it was] <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>.

¶ And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let us <p-w s=H6213>make</p-w> <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> in our <p-w s=H6754>image</p-w>, after our <p-w s=H1823>likeness</p-w>: and let them have <p-w s=H7287>dominion</p-w> over the <p-w s=H1710>fish</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3220>sea</p-w>, and over the <p-w s=H5775>fowl</p-w> of the <p-w s=H8064>air</p-w>, and over the <p-w s=H929>cattle</p-w>, and over all the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>, and over every creeping <p-w s=H7431>thing</p-w> that <p-w s=H7430>creepeth</p-w> upon the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>.

So <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> in his [own] <p-w s=H6754>image</p-w>, in the <p-w s=H6754>image</p-w> of <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> he him; <p-w s=H2145>male</p-w> and <p-w s=H5347>female</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> he them.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1288>blessed</p-w> them, and <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> unto them, Be <p-w s=H6509>fruitful</p-w>, and <p-w s=H7235>multiply</p-w>, and <p-w s=H4390>replenish</p-w> the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>, and subdue <p-w s=H3533>it</p-w>: and have <p-w s=H7287>dominion</p-w> over the <p-w s=H1710>fish</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3220>sea</p-w>, and over the <p-w s=H5775>fowl</p-w> of the <p-w s=H8064>air</p-w>, and over every living <p-w s=H2416>thing</p-w> that <p-w s=H7430>moveth</p-w> upon the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>.

¶ And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, <p-w s=H2009>Behold</p-w>, I have <p-w s=H5414>given</p-w> you every <p-w s=H6212>herb</p-w> <p-w s=H2232>bearing</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>seed</p-w>, which [is] upon the <p-w s=H6440>face</p-w> of all the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>, and every <p-w s=H6086>tree</p-w>, in the which [is] the <p-w s=H6529>fruit</p-w> of a <p-w s=H6086>tree</p-w> <p-w s=H2232>yielding</p-w> <p-w s=H2233>seed</p-w>; to you it shall <p-w s=H1961>be</p-w> for <p-w s=H402>meat</p-w>.

And to every <p-w s=H2416>beast</p-w> of the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>, and to every <p-w s=H5775>fowl</p-w> of the <p-w s=H8064>air</p-w>, and to every thing that <p-w s=H7430>creepeth</p-w> upon the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w>, wherein [there is] <p-w s=H2416>life</p-w>, [I have given] every <p-w s=H3418>green</p-w> <p-w s=H6212>herb</p-w> for <p-w s=H402>meat</p-w>: and it was so.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7200>saw</p-w> every thing <p-w s=H834>that</p-w> he had <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w>, and, behold, [it was] <p-w s=H3966>very</p-w> <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>. And the <p-w s=H6153>evening</p-w> and the <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w> were the <p-w s=H8345>sixth</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.
Thus the <p-w s=H8064>heavens</p-w> and the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> were <p-w s=H3615>finished</p-w>, and all the host of <p-w s=H6635>them</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1288>blessed</p-w> the <p-w s=H7637>seventh</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>, and <p-w s=H6942>sanctified</p-w> it: <p-w s=H3588>because</p-w> that in it he had <p-w s=H7673>rested</p-w> from all his <p-w s=H4399>work</p-w> which <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w> and <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w>.

¶ <p-w s=H428>These</p-w> [are] the <p-w s=H8435>generations</p-w> of the <p-w s=H8064>heavens</p-w> and of the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> when they were <p-w s=H1254>created</p-w>, in the <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> that the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> the <p-w s=H776>earth</p-w> and the <p-w s=H8064>heavens</p-w>,

And the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H3335>formed</p-w> <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> [of] the <p-w s=H6083>dust</p-w> <p-w s=H4480>of</p-w> the <p-w s=H127>ground</p-w>, and <p-w s=H5301>breathed</p-w> into his <p-w s=H639>nostrils</p-w> the <p-w s=H5397>breath</p-w> of <p-w s=H2416>life</p-w>; and <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> became a <p-w s=H2416>living</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>soul</p-w>.

¶ And the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H5193>planted</p-w> a <p-w s=H1588>garden</p-w> <p-w s=H6924>eastward</p-w> in <p-w s=H5731>Eden</p-w>; and <p-w s=H8033>there</p-w> he <p-w s=H7760>put</p-w> the <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> <p-w s=H834>whom</p-w> he had <p-w s=H3335>formed</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H4480>out</p-w> of the <p-w s=H127>ground</p-w> <p-w s=H6779>made</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> to <p-w s=H6779>grow</p-w> every <p-w s=H6086>tree</p-w> that is <p-w s=H2530>pleasant</p-w> to the <p-w s=H4758>sight</p-w>, and <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w> for <p-w s=H3978>food</p-w>; the <p-w s=H6086>tree</p-w> of <p-w s=H2416>life</p-w> also in the <p-w s=H8432>midst</p-w> of the <p-w s=H1588>garden</p-w>, and the <p-w s=H6086>tree</p-w> of <p-w s=H1847>knowledge</p-w> of <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w> and <p-w s=H7451>evil</p-w>.

¶ And <p-w s=H6547>Pharaoh</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>called</p-w> <p-w s=H413>for</p-w> <p-w s=H4872>Moses</p-w> and for <p-w s=H175>Aaron</p-w>, and <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, <p-w s=H3212>Go</p-w> ye, <p-w s=H2076>sacrifice</p-w> to your <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> in the <p-w s=H776>land</p-w>.

¶ And the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>spake</p-w> unto <p-w s=H4872>Moses</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>,

¶ He that <p-w s=H5060>toucheth</p-w> the <p-w s=H4191>dead</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>body</p-w> of any <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> shall be <p-w s=H2930>unclean</p-w> <p-w s=H7651>seven</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w>.

Whosoever <p-w s=H5060>toucheth</p-w> the <p-w s=H4191>dead</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>body</p-w> of any <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> that is <p-w s=H4191>dead</p-w>, and <p-w s=H2398>purifieth</p-w> not himself, <p-w s=H2930>defileth</p-w> the <p-w s=H4908>tabernacle</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w>; and that <p-w s=H5315>soul</p-w> shall be cut <p-w s=H3772>off</p-w> from <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w>: because the <p-w s=H4325>water</p-w> of <p-w s=H5079>separation</p-w> was not <p-w s=H2236>sprinkled</p-w> upon him, he shall be <p-w s=H2931>unclean</p-w>; his <p-w s=H2932>uncleanness</p-w> [is] yet upon him.

This [is] the <p-w s=H8451>law</p-w>, when a <p-w s=H120>man</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>dieth</p-w> in a <p-w s=H168>tent</p-w>: all that <p-w s=H935>come</p-w> into the <p-w s=H168>tent</p-w>, and all that [is] in the <p-w s=H168>tent</p-w>, shall be <p-w s=H2930>unclean</p-w> <p-w s=H7651>seven</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w>.

The <p-w s=H368>Emims</p-w> <p-w s=H3427>dwelt</p-w> therein in times <p-w s=H6440>past</p-w>, a <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w> <p-w s=H1419>great</p-w>, and <p-w s=H7227>many</p-w>, and <p-w s=H7311>tall</p-w>, as the <p-w s=H6062>Anakims</p-w>;

<p-w s=H1992>Which</p-w> also were <p-w s=H2803>accounted</p-w> <p-w s=H7497>giants</p-w>, as the <p-w s=H6062>Anakims</p-w>; but the <p-w s=H4125>Moabites</p-w> <p-w s=H7121>call</p-w> them <p-w s=H368>Emims</p-w>.

And I fell <p-w s=H5307>down</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w>, as at the <p-w s=H7223>first</p-w>, <p-w s=H705>forty</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w> and <p-w s=H705>forty</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>nights</p-w>: I did neither <p-w s=H398>eat</p-w> <p-w s=H3899>bread</p-w>, nor <p-w s=H8354>drink</p-w> <p-w s=H4325>water</p-w>, because of all your <p-w s=H2403>sins</p-w> which ye <p-w s=H2398>sinned</p-w>, in <p-w s=H6213>doing</p-w> <p-w s=H7451>wickedly</p-w> in the <p-w s=H5869>sight</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w>, to provoke him to <p-w s=H3707>anger</p-w>.

For I was <p-w s=H3025>afraid</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>of</p-w> the <p-w s=H639>anger</p-w> and hot <p-w s=H2534>displeasure</p-w>, wherewith the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> was <p-w s=H7107>wroth</p-w> against you to <p-w s=H8045>destroy</p-w> you. But the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>hearkened</p-w> unto me at that <p-w s=H6471>time</p-w> also.

And the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> was <p-w s=H3966>very</p-w> <p-w s=H599>angry</p-w> with <p-w s=H175>Aaron</p-w> to have <p-w s=H8045>destroyed</p-w> him: and I <p-w s=H6419>prayed</p-w> for <p-w s=H175>Aaron</p-w> also the same <p-w s=H6256>time</p-w>.

And I <p-w s=H3947>took</p-w> your <p-w s=H2403>sin</p-w>, the <p-w s=H5695>calf</p-w> which ye had <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w>, and <p-w s=H8313>burnt</p-w> it with <p-w s=H784>fire</p-w>, and <p-w s=H3807>stamped</p-w> it, [and] <p-w s=H2912>ground</p-w> [it] very <p-w s=H3190>small</p-w>, [even] until it was as <p-w s=H1854>small</p-w> as <p-w s=H6083>dust</p-w>: and I <p-w s=H7993>cast</p-w> the <p-w s=H6083>dust</p-w> thereof into the <p-w s=H5158>brook</p-w> that descended <p-w s=H3381>out</p-w> of the <p-w s=H2022>mount</p-w>.
And at <p-w s=H8404>Taberah</p-w>, and at <p-w s=H4532>Massah</p-w>, and at <p-w s=H6914>Kibroth-hattaavah</p-w>, ye provoked the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> to <p-w s=H7107>wrath</p-w>.

Likewise when the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H7971>sent</p-w> you from <p-w s=H6947>Kadesh-barnea</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>, Go <p-w s=H5927>up</p-w> and <p-w s=H3423>possess</p-w> the <p-w s=H776>land</p-w> which I have <p-w s=H5414>given</p-w> you; then ye <p-w s=H4784>rebelled</p-w> against the <p-w s=H6310>commandment</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> your <p-w s=H430>God</p-w>, and ye <p-w s=H539>believed</p-w> him not, nor <p-w s=H8085>hearkened</p-w> to his <p-w s=H6963>voice</p-w>.
Ye have been <p-w s=H4784>rebellious</p-w> against the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> from the <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> that I <p-w s=H3045>knew</p-w> you.

Thus I fell <p-w s=H5307>down</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H705>forty</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w> and <p-w s=H705>forty</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>nights</p-w>, as I fell <p-w s=H5307>down</p-w> [at the first;] because the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> had <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> he would <p-w s=H8045>destroy</p-w> you.

I <p-w s=H6419>prayed</p-w> therefore unto the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w>, and <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, O <p-w s=H136>Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3069>GOD</p-w>, <p-w s=H7843>destroy</p-w> not thy <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w> and thine <p-w s=H5159>inheritance</p-w>, which thou hast <p-w s=H6299>redeemed</p-w> through thy <p-w s=H1433>greatness</p-w>, which thou hast brought <p-w s=H3318>forth</p-w> out of <p-w s=H4714>Egypt</p-w> with a <p-w s=H2389>mighty</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>hand</p-w>.

<p-w s=H2142>Remember</p-w> thy <p-w s=H5650>servants</p-w>, <p-w s=H85>Abraham</p-w>, <p-w s=H3327>Isaac</p-w>, and <p-w s=H3290>Jacob</p-w>; <p-w s=H6437>look</p-w> not unto the <p-w s=H7190>stubbornness</p-w> of this <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w>, nor to their <p-w s=H7562>wickedness</p-w>, nor to their <p-w s=H2403>sin</p-w>:

Lest the <p-w s=H776>land</p-w> whence thou broughtest us <p-w s=H3318>out</p-w> <p-w s=H559>say</p-w>, Because the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> was not <p-w s=H3201>able</p-w> to <p-w s=H935>bring</p-w> them into the <p-w s=H776>land</p-w> which he <p-w s=H1696>promised</p-w> them, and because he <p-w s=H8135>hated</p-w> them, he hath brought them <p-w s=H3318>out</p-w> to <p-w s=H4191>slay</p-w> them in the <p-w s=H4057>wilderness</p-w>.

Yet they [are] thy <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w> and thine <p-w s=H5159>inheritance</p-w>, which thou broughtest <p-w s=H3318>out</p-w> by thy <p-w s=H1419>mighty</p-w> <p-w s=H3581>power</p-w> and by thy stretched <p-w s=H5186>out</p-w> <p-w s=H2220>arm</p-w>.

At that <p-w s=H6256>time</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> unto me, <p-w s=H6458>Hew</p-w> thee <p-w s=H8147>two</p-w> <p-w s=H3871>tables</p-w> of <p-w s=H68>stone</p-w> like unto the <p-w s=H7223>first</p-w>, and come <p-w s=H5927>up</p-w> unto me into the <p-w s=H2022>mount</p-w>, and <p-w s=H6213>make</p-w> thee an <p-w s=H727>ark</p-w> of <p-w s=H6086>wood</p-w>.

And I will <p-w s=H3789>write</p-w> on the <p-w s=H3871>tables</p-w> the <p-w s=H1697>words</p-w> that were in the <p-w s=H7223>first</p-w> <p-w s=H3871>tables</p-w> which thou <p-w s=H7665>brakest</p-w>, and thou shalt <p-w s=H7760>put</p-w> them in the <p-w s=H727>ark</p-w>.

And I <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w> an <p-w s=H727>ark</p-w> [of] <p-w s=H7848>shittim</p-w> <p-w s=H6086>wood</p-w>, and <p-w s=H6458>hewed</p-w> <p-w s=H8147>two</p-w> <p-w s=H3871>tables</p-w> of <p-w s=H68>stone</p-w> like unto the <p-w s=H7223>first</p-w>, and went <p-w s=H5927>up</p-w> into the <p-w s=H2022>mount</p-w>, having the <p-w s=H8147>two</p-w> <p-w s=H3871>tables</p-w> in mine <p-w s=H3027>hand</p-w>.

And he <p-w s=H3789>wrote</p-w> on the <p-w s=H3871>tables</p-w>, according to the <p-w s=H7223>first</p-w> <p-w s=H4385>writing</p-w>, the <p-w s=H6235>ten</p-w> <p-w s=H1697>commandments</p-w>, which the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H1696>spake</p-w> unto you in the <p-w s=H2022>mount</p-w> out of the <p-w s=H8432>midst</p-w> of the <p-w s=H784>fire</p-w> in the <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> of the <p-w s=H6951>assembly</p-w>: and the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H5414>gave</p-w> them unto me.

And I <p-w s=H6437>turned</p-w> myself and came <p-w s=H3381>down</p-w> from the <p-w s=H2022>mount</p-w>, and <p-w s=H7760>put</p-w> the <p-w s=H3871>tables</p-w> in the <p-w s=H727>ark</p-w> which I had <p-w s=H6213>made</p-w>; and there they be, as the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H6680>commanded</p-w> me.

¶ And the <p-w s=H1121>children</p-w> of <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w> took their <p-w s=H5265>journey</p-w> from Beeroth of the children of <p-w s=H885>Jaakan</p-w> to <p-w s=H4149>Mosera</p-w>: there <p-w s=H175>Aaron</p-w> <p-w s=H4191>died</p-w>, and there he was <p-w s=H6912>buried</p-w>; and <p-w s=H499>Eleazar</p-w> his <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> ministered in the <p-w s=H3547>priest’s office</p-w> in his stead.

¶ At that <p-w s=H6256>time</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H914>separated</p-w> the <p-w s=H7626>tribe</p-w> of <p-w s=H3878>Levi</p-w>, to <p-w s=H5375>bear</p-w> the <p-w s=H727>ark</p-w> of the <p-w s=H1285>covenant</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w>, to <p-w s=H5975>stand</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> to <p-w s=H8334>minister</p-w> unto him, and to <p-w s=H1288>bless</p-w> in his <p-w s=H8034>name</p-w>, unto this <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

And I <p-w s=H5975>stayed</p-w> in the <p-w s=H2022>mount</p-w>, according to the <p-w s=H7223>first</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>time</p-w>, <p-w s=H705>forty</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w> and <p-w s=H705>forty</p-w> <p-w s=H3915>nights</p-w>; and the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H8085>hearkened</p-w> unto me at that <p-w s=H6471>time</p-w> also, [and] the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H14>would</p-w> not <p-w s=H7843>destroy</p-w> thee.

And the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w> unto me, <p-w s=H6965>Arise</p-w>, <p-w s=H3212>take</p-w> [thy] <p-w s=H4550>journey</p-w> <p-w s=H6440>before</p-w> the <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w>, that they may go <p-w s=H935>in</p-w> and <p-w s=H3423>possess</p-w> the <p-w s=H776>land</p-w>, which I <p-w s=H7650>sware</p-w> unto their <p-w s=H1>fathers</p-w> to <p-w s=H5414>give</p-w> unto them.

¶ And now, <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w>, what doth the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> thy <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H7592>require</p-w> of thee, but to <p-w s=H3372>fear</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> thy <p-w s=H430>God</p-w>, to <p-w s=H3212>walk</p-w> in all his <p-w s=H1870>ways</p-w>, and to <p-w s=H157>love</p-w> him, and to <p-w s=H5647>serve</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> thy <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> with all thy <p-w s=H3824>heart</p-w> and with all thy <p-w s=H5315>soul</p-w>,

To <p-w s=H8104>keep</p-w> the <p-w s=H4687>commandments</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w>, and his <p-w s=H2708>statutes</p-w>, which I <p-w s=H6680>command</p-w> thee this <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w> for thy <p-w s=H2896>good</p-w>?

Only the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> had a <p-w s=H2836>delight</p-w> in thy <p-w s=H1>fathers</p-w> to <p-w s=H157>love</p-w> them, and he <p-w s=H977>chose</p-w> their <p-w s=H2233>seed</p-w> <p-w s=H310>after</p-w> them, [even] you above all <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w>, as [it is] this <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.
<p-w s=H4135>Circumcise</p-w> therefore the <p-w s=H6190>foreskin</p-w> of your <p-w s=H3824>heart</p-w>, and be no more <p-w s=H6203>stiffnecked</p-w>.

He doth <p-w s=H6213>execute</p-w> the <p-w s=H4941>judgment</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3490>fatherless</p-w> and <p-w s=H490>widow</p-w>, and <p-w s=H157>loveth</p-w> the <p-w s=H1616>stranger</p-w>, in <p-w s=H5414>giving</p-w> him <p-w s=H3899>food</p-w> and <p-w s=H8071>raiment</p-w>.
<p-w s=H157>Love</p-w> ye therefore the <p-w s=H1616>stranger</p-w>: for ye were <p-w s=H1616>strangers</p-w> in the <p-w s=H776>land</p-w> of <p-w s=H4714>Egypt</p-w>.

Thou shalt <p-w s=H3372>fear</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> thy <p-w s=H430>God</p-w>; him shalt thou <p-w s=H5647>serve</p-w>, and to him shalt thou <p-w s=H1692>cleave</p-w>, and <p-w s=H7650>swear</p-w> by his <p-w s=H8034>name</p-w>.

He [is] thy <p-w s=H8416>praise</p-w>, and he [is] thy <p-w s=H430>God</p-w>, that hath <p-w s=H6213>done</p-w> for thee these <p-w s=H1419>great</p-w> and terrible <p-w s=H3372>things</p-w>, which thine <p-w s=H5869>eyes</p-w> have <p-w s=H7200>seen</p-w>.

Thy <p-w s=H1>fathers</p-w> went <p-w s=H3381>down</p-w> into <p-w s=H4714>Egypt</p-w> with threescore and <p-w s=H7657>ten</p-w> <p-w s=H5315>persons</p-w>; and now the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> thy <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> hath <p-w s=H7760>made</p-w> thee as the <p-w s=H3556>stars</p-w> of <p-w s=H8064>heaven</p-w> for <p-w s=H7230>multitude</p-w>.

Therefore thou shalt <p-w s=H157>love</p-w> the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> thy <p-w s=H430>God</p-w>, and <p-w s=H8104>keep</p-w> his <p-w s=H4931>charge</p-w>, and his <p-w s=H2708>statutes</p-w>, and his <p-w s=H4941>judgments</p-w>, and his <p-w s=H4687>commandments</p-w>, <p-w s=H3117>alway</p-w>.

And <p-w s=H3045>know</p-w> ye this <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>: for [I speak] not with your <p-w s=H1121>children</p-w> which have not <p-w s=H3045>known</p-w>, and which have not <p-w s=H7200>seen</p-w> the <p-w s=H4148>chastisement</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> your <p-w s=H430>God</p-w>, his <p-w s=H1433>greatness</p-w>, his <p-w s=H2389>mighty</p-w> <p-w s=H3027>hand</p-w>, and his stretched <p-w s=H5186>out</p-w> <p-w s=H2220>arm</p-w>,

And his <p-w s=H226>miracles</p-w>, and his <p-w s=H4639>acts</p-w>, which he <p-w s=H6213>did</p-w> in the <p-w s=H8432>midst</p-w> of <p-w s=H4714>Egypt</p-w> unto <p-w s=H6547>Pharaoh</p-w> the <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> of <p-w s=H4714>Egypt</p-w>, and unto all his <p-w s=H776>land</p-w>;

¶ Then <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> the <p-w s=H4397>messengers</p-w> to <p-w s=H1390>Gibeah</p-w> of <p-w s=H7586>Saul</p-w>, and <p-w s=H1696>told</p-w> the <p-w s=H1697>tidings</p-w> in the <p-w s=H241>ears</p-w> of the <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w>: and all the <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w> lifted <p-w s=H5375>up</p-w> their <p-w s=H6963>voices</p-w>, and <p-w s=H1058>wept</p-w>.

¶ And <p-w s=H7586>Saul</p-w> <p-w s=H559>said</p-w>, Let us go <p-w s=H3381>down</p-w> <p-w s=H310>after</p-w> the <p-w s=H6430>Philistines</p-w> by <p-w s=H3915>night</p-w>, and <p-w s=H962>spoil</p-w> them until the <p-w s=H1242>morning</p-w> <p-w s=H216>light</p-w>, and let us not <p-w s=H7604>leave</p-w> a <p-w s=H376>man</p-w> of them. ¶ So <p-w s=H7586>Saul</p-w> <p-w s=H3920>took</p-w> the <p-w s=H4410>kingdom</p-w> over <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w>, and <p-w s=H3898>fought</p-w> against all his <p-w s=H341>enemies</p-w> on every <p-w s=H5439>side</p-w>, against <p-w s=H4124>Moab</p-w>, and against the <p-w s=H1121>children</p-w> of <p-w s=H5983>Ammon</p-w>, and against <p-w s=H123>Edom</p-w>, and against the <p-w s=H4428>kings</p-w> of <p-w s=H6678>Zobah</p-w>, and against the <p-w s=H6430>Philistines</p-w>: and whithersoever he <p-w s=H6437>turned</p-w> himself, he <p-w s=H7561>vexed</p-w> [them].

¶ Then came the <p-w s=H1697>word</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w> unto <p-w s=H8050>Samuel</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>,

¶ Then <p-w s=H8050>Samuel</p-w> <p-w s=H3212>went</p-w> to <p-w s=H7414>Ramah</p-w>; and <p-w s=H7586>Saul</p-w> went <p-w s=H5927>up</p-w> to his <p-w s=H1004>house</p-w> to <p-w s=H1390>Gibeah</p-w> of <p-w s=H7586>Saul</p-w>.

¶ So <p-w s=H3379>Jeroboam</p-w> and all the <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w> <p-w s=H935>came</p-w> to <p-w s=H7346>Rehoboam</p-w> the <p-w s=H7992>third</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>, as the <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> had <p-w s=H1696>appointed</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>, Come to me <p-w s=H7725>again</p-w> the <p-w s=H7992>third</p-w> <p-w s=H3117>day</p-w>.

<p-w s=H559>Speak</p-w> unto <p-w s=H7346>Rehoboam</p-w>, the <p-w s=H1121>son</p-w> of <p-w s=H8010>Solomon</p-w>, <p-w s=H4428>king</p-w> of <p-w s=H3063>Judah</p-w>, and unto all the <p-w s=H1004>house</p-w> of <p-w s=H3063>Judah</p-w> and <p-w s=H1144>Benjamin</p-w>, and to the <p-w s=H3499>remnant</p-w> of the <p-w s=H5971>people</p-w>, <p-w s=H559>saying</p-w>,

<p-w s=H6213>Did</p-w> not your <p-w s=H1>fathers</p-w> thus, and <p-w s=H935>did</p-w> not our <p-w s=H430>God</p-w> <p-w s=H935>bring</p-w> all this <p-w s=H7451>evil</p-w> upon us, and upon this <p-w s=H5892>city</p-w>? yet ye <p-w s=H935>bring</p-w> <p-w s=H3254>more</p-w> <p-w s=H2740>wrath</p-w> upon <p-w s=H3478>Israel</p-w> by <p-w s=H2490>profaning</p-w> the <p-w s=H7676>sabbath</p-w>.

¶ Behold, the <p-w s=H3117>days</p-w> <p-w s=H935>come</p-w>, <p-w s=H5002>saith</p-w> the <p-w s=H136>Lord</p-w> <p-w s=H3069>GOD</p-w>, that I will <p-w s=H7971>send</p-w> a <p-w s=H7458>famine</p-w> in the <p-w s=H776>land</p-w>, not a <p-w s=H7458>famine</p-w> of <p-w s=H3899>bread</p-w>, nor a <p-w s=H6772>thirst</p-w> for <p-w s=H4325>water</p-w>, but of <p-w s=H8085>hearing</p-w> the <p-w s=H1697>words</p-w> of the <p-w s=H3068>LORD</p-w>:

The <p-w s=H2377>vision</p-w> of <p-w s=H5662>Obadiah</p-w>.
